**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

Section 8 (Term and Renewal) meets the preferred position on every material term of the RENEWAL rule:

- **Renewal term length** — successive *twelve-month* periods (§8.2); no multi-year auto-renewal, so no walk-away risk.
- **Non-renewal notice window** — Customer opt-out on *thirty days'* written notice, at the preferred ≤30-day threshold and well inside the ≤60-day fallback.
- **Vendor reminder** — §8.2 requires a reminder at least *sixty days* before renewal, and adds a customer-favourable backstop: if the reminder is missed, the opt-out deadline extends to thirty days after it is received.
- **Price uplift cap** — §8.3 caps renewal increases at *the lesser of US CPI over the preceding twelve months and three percent*, plus ninety days' notice and no increase on prepaid periods.

I also checked Section 7 for a competing escalation mechanism; §7.1 fixes Fees during the initial term and bars undisclosed surcharges, so there is no conflicting uplift path.
